gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-sc: Rounded, cord-like strokes make Grandstander bold and expressive at a glance. Noto Sans SC, a modern sans-serif with ascenders that barely clear the x-height, runs smoothly through paragraphs of text.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Noto Sans Siddham reads approachably, its large central band filling each line generously. And Grandstander, with no pressure swell in its lines, can go large while the sans stays at ordinary text size.

gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-tai-vie: Grandstander bends its letters like wire signs, bold and constant in thickness. And Noto Sans Tai Viet does the text work, its terminals pulled back from each curve's closing point.
